formula.ascii: candidate: sample i with value v that is no lower than its +-2 neighbours (equal on the left rejects); per side walk up to window samples, lowest = min of the values seen, stop at the first sample higher than v; reject if either side has fewer than minimumSide valid samples; prominence = v - max(lowestLeft, lowestRight), rejected below minimumProminence; kept peaks survive non-maximum suppression within suppressionRadius samples, ranked by prominence (gated rounds)
